aligner_self_identification.note: PRIMARY mapper diagnostic. Each canonical proposition's own surface text and its negated form are fed back as pseudo-claims; no model output, no reasoning and no truth label is involved, so a failure here is unambiguously a measurement failure.

lexical_reference.note: SECONDARY and deliberately partial. The lexical reference fires only on near-verbatim non-conditional restatements, so it covers a small fraction of observations. Recall against it is meaningful; PRECISION against it is not reported, because an aligner observation absent from a low-coverage reference is unlabelled rather than wrong.

alignment_audit.note: measures the MAPPER, not whether the agent was right (that is panel accuracy, in E0).

em_parameters.note: estimated from the vote matrix alone; no truth labels consumed
